data.body:
[P2] Retire the quarantine after successful recovery

If example teardown creates `quarantine.json`, a subsequent `settle` or new deployment can successfully verify quiescence here, but neither removes that file. Both `run-examples.mjs` and `sharedLmi.before()` reject any existing quarantine, so even a fresh run ID remains blocked in the same checkout after successful recovery. Archive or clear the recovered run's quarantine after successful settlement or verified redeployment, retaining it on failure. Add a regression covering a quarantined run followed by successful recovery and a new run.
